name: Aethis the Sorrow
bio: Only Serenity knows who, or what, Aethis weeps for. Armed with the Swords of Lament, this avenging Angel hopes to wash away Malice's minions in a storm of sorrow and steel. Many Lightseekers have tried to cheer this perpetually downcast Angel up, but to no avail. Don't be so glum Aethis, it might never happen! Do we see a little smile there?
